components.css: .ds-btn--ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; background: var(--ink, #132a42); color: var(--paper, #f3efe3); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #132a42); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn--ink:hover { background: #1d3d5d; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn--ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #0a6d87); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The secondary action: transparent with a 1px ink rule.
components.html: ติดต่อ
components.css: .ds-btn--outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #132a42); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #132a42); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn--outline:hover { background: var(--cyan-wash, rgba(10,109,135,0.08)); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn--outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #0a6d87); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Index Tab
components.description: The manila index tab that attaches to the right edge of the book; active tab becomes paper with a cyan punched hole.
components.html: ตัวตน
components.css: .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 46px; padding: 9px 12px 9px 14px; background: var(--manila, #d9bd8f); color: var(--ink, #132a42); border: 1px solid var(--manila-dark, #b3925c); border-left: 0; border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); font-family: var(--font-display, sans-serif); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab__hole { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--desk, #071725); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } .ds-tab--active { background: var(--paper-3, #fbf8ee); color: var(--ink, #132a42); border-color: var(--paper-edge, #d7cab0); } .ds-tab--active .ds-tab__hole { background: var(--cyan, #0a6d87); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--cyan, #0a6d87); }

components.name: Work Register Tab
components.description: A work-order row in the project register; selected rows take the cyan wash and the order number turns ink.
components.css: .ds-work-tab { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 14px 6px 14px 0; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(19,42,66,0.16); color: var(--ink, #132a42); font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-work-tab[aria-selected="true"] { padding-left: 9px; background: var(--cyan-wash, rgba(10,109,135,0.08)); } .ds-work-tab__num { padding-top: 2px; color: var(--cyan, #0a6d87); font-family: var(--font-code, monospace); font-size: 10px; } .ds-work-tab[aria-selected="true"] .ds-work-tab__num { color: var(--ink, #132a42); font-weight: 500; } .ds-work-tab__body strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display, sans-serif); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-work-tab__body small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--ink-faint, #566574); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-work-tab__state { align-self: start; padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--cyan, #0a6d87); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--cyan, #0a6d87); font-family: var(--font-code, monospace); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-work-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #0a6d87); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a hardback service log dropped open on a dark workbench. Paper is the page itself, never a card floating on a page: the navy cloth cover, the grid paper, the manila index tabs, the tape holding the portrait, and one red rubber stamp make the record feel maintained rather than decorated. The world stays quiet so the content can be loud: a recruiter should remember a working record, not a theme.

The logbook devices are functional, not costume. The right-edge tabs are the navigation; the project register is a real tablist with keyboard support; the selected work order is a taped-in sheet; the POS test login is printed where it can be used. On mobile the spread stacks into one page and a compact "3 live systems" proof strip keeps the work inside the first viewport.

The voice is Thai-first and direct. The record is optimistic without hype: every claim is visible in the page or one click away.
keyCharacteristics: Warm grid paper as the ground, framed by a navy cloth cover on a dark workbench.
Manila index tabs on the right edge; a sticky rail on desktop, a paper drawer on mobile.
Squared technical display type, calm Thai body type, and mono record labels.
One red availability stamp; cyan is reserved for the index, links, and live states.
Work orders with live demos and a working POS test login.
A single light world; no dark-mode toggle in this system.

rules.name: The Paper Ground Rule
rules.body: The page is paper. Do not turn the paper into a stack of rounded cards; sections are ruled records, tabs, and taped sheets.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Red appears once, as the availability stamp. If red is used for status, errors, or decoration, the mark loses its meaning.

rules.name: The Index Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks the current place and the live path: the active tab hole, links, focus, and live badges. It never becomes a gradient or a glow.

rules.name: The Name Rule
rules.body: Set the Thai name in Anuphan 700. The display face may run the section titles; it never runs the name a recruiter has to read first.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Mono type is for metadata, codes, numbers, and status. Thai body copy is always Anuphan.

rules.name: The Physical Layer Rule
rules.body: Every shadow belongs to an object that could exist on the desk: cover, paper, tape, tab, photo. No zero-offset glows.

dos: Do keep paper as the page ground and the dark workbench outside it.
Do use the right-edge tabs as the desktop index and the paper drawer as the mobile index.
Do set the Thai name in Anuphan 700 and section titles in Chakra Petch.
Do keep the red stamp rare and literal: availability, not decoration.
Do keep the live project demos and working test logins visible.
Do keep the mobile "3 live systems" proof strip in the first viewport.
Do hold 44px touch targets, visible focus, reduced motion, and Thai line lengths.
donts: Don't turn sections into equal rounded cards or nested cards.
Don't use gradient text, glass panels, emoji icons, or a colored side stripe on rows.
Don't set Thai body copy in the mono face.
Don't add a dark-mode toggle; this system is one light record.
Don't invent employers, clients, user counts, or metrics.
Don't let the display face set the name or a long Thai paragraph.
Don't hide the project proof below the mobile fold.
